E1208

Toolchain `jet:` field in `package.jet` incompatible (M12.1)

What

Toolchain `jet:` field in `package.jet` incompatible (M12.1)

Why

The registered jet rule applies here. A `jet build` run reports this toolchain-pin error.

Fix

Set a compatible `jet:` toolchain pin in `package.jet`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E1208: tests/ui/manifest_toolchain/stderr.

Error [jet.ToolchainVersionMismatch]: This project requires Jet `>=99.0.0` but this is Jet a0.0.45
 Why: The top-level `jet` field specifies a minimum toolchain version
 Fix: Update Jet to a newer version, or change the `jet` field in `package.jet`
